children: Vivmark Residential published an investor presentation and operating update tied to its participation in the BofA Securities Global Real Estate Conference, reaffirming a 2026 Same Store Residential revenue outlook and reporting rent and occupancy metrics.
Published investor presentation and operating update for BofA Global Real Estate Conference on Sept 16, 2026.
Sets full-year 2026 Same Store Residential revenue outlook at 2% midpoint, consistent with prior AVB and EQR outlooks.
Net effective asking rents up 3.6% year-over-year as of Sept 11, 2026.
Physical occupancy reported at 95.7% and renewal rate of 60%, indicating continued operating strength.
